items.a: Every treatment is delivered by a medically qualified practitioner using licensed, premium products. A full medical consultation and consent process takes place before any treatment begins.
All treatments are performed by Nikoo, a medically trained aesthetic practitioner with extensive experience in facial anatomy and injectable techniques.
We use only clinically approved, premium-grade products sourced through regulated UK suppliers, chosen for their safety profile and natural-looking results.
Most treatments involve little to no downtime. Some mild swelling, redness or tenderness can occur and typically settles within 24–72 hours depending on the treatment.
You'll receive clear written aftercare guidance following your treatment, along with direct access to your practitioner should you have any questions during recovery.
This varies by treatment, from three to four months for anti-wrinkle injections up to eighteen months for structural filler. Your practitioner will discuss expected longevity during consultation.
Yes. Our philosophy is subtle enhancement, not transformation. Treatment plans are tailored to your individual anatomy to preserve and enhance your natural features.

items.q: Do I need a consultation first?
items.a: Yes, every new client begins with a thorough consultation to discuss goals, medical history and suitability before any treatment is planned.

items.q: How do I book an appointment?
items.a: You can book your consultation directly online using the Book Appointment button found throughout the site.
